grammar_archive.topic: Past Perfect Continuous (o'tmishdagi boshqa harakatdan oldingi davomiylikni ta'kidlash)

parts.1: ⏳ Past Perfect Continuous zamoni: Umumiy tushuncha (1/5) 📌 Past Perfect Continuous (O'tmish tugallangan davomli zamon) o'tmishda sodir bo'lgan boshqa bir harakatdan oldin ma'lum bir vaqt davomida uzluksiz davom etgan jarayonni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi. Bu zamonda asosiy diqqat-e'tibor harakatning qancha vaqt davom etganligiga va uning davomiyligini ta'kidlashga qaratiladi. Ya'ni o'tmishdagi ikkinchi harakat ro'y berguniga qadar birinchi harakat muayyan muddat davom etgan bo'ladi. Ushbu grammatik qoida o'zbek tiliga ko'pincha "...-ayotgan edi" yoki "...-ib kelayotgan edi" shaklida tarjima qilinadi. 💡 Misollar: • They had been waiting for two hours before the bus arrived. (Avtobus kelguniga qadar ular ikki soat davomida kutishayotgan edi.) • She had been studying English for three years before she moved to London. (U Londonga ko'chib o'tishidan oldin uch yil davomida ingliz tilini o'rganib kelayotgan edi.) 📝 Keyingi qismlarda ushbu zamonning darak, inkor va so'roq gap tuzilishlarini batafsil ko'rib chiqamiz. Bizni kuzatishda davom eting!
parts.2: ⏳ Past Perfect Continuous: Darak gaplar (2/5) 📌 Darak gap formulasi: Subject + had + been + Verb-ing (Barcha egalar — I, you, he, she, it, we, they uchun o'zgarmasdan had been ishlatiladi.) 💡 Ushbu zamon o'tmishdagi boshqa bir harakat sodir bo'lguniga qadar ma'lum bir harakatning qancha vaqt davom etganini ta'kidlash uchun xizmat qiladi. 📖 Misollar: 🗣️ She had been waiting for two hours when the bus finally arrived. (Avtobus nihoyat kelganida, u ikki soatdan beri kutayotgan edi.) 🗣️ They had been playing football before it started to rain. (Yomg'ir yog'ishni boshlashidan oldin ular futbol o'ynashayotgan edi.) 🗣️ I had been working at that company for five years when I got promoted. (Lavozimim oshirilganida, men u kompaniyada besh yildan beri ishlayotgan edim.) 🗣️ He was very tired because he had been running in the park. (U juda charchagan edi, chunki bog'da yugurib yurgan edi.) ❗ Muhim eslatma: Ko'pchilik o'quvchilar been so'zini tushirib qoldirishadi. Shunchaki had working deyish xatodir. Harakatning davomiyligini ko'rsatish uchun albatta had been + V-ing birikmasini to'liq ishlating!
parts.3: 📚 Past Perfect Continuous: Inkor gaplar (3/5) 📌 Inkor gapning yasalish formulasi: Ega + had not (hadn't) + been + V-ing 💡 O'tmishdagi ma'lum bir vaqt yoki boshqa bir harakatgacha jarayonning davom etmaganini ta'kidlash uchun hadn't been birikmasi ishlatiladi. 🗣️ Misollar: 🔹 They hadn't been waiting for long when the train arrived. (Poyezd kelganida ular uzoq kutishmayotgan edi.) 🔹 She hadn't been working there for very long when she quit. (U ishdan bo'shaganida u yerda ko'pdan beri ishlamayotgan edi.) 🔹 It hadn't been raining much, so the roads were dry. (Ko'p yomg'ir yog'mayotgan edi, shuning uchun yo'llar quruq edi.) 🔹 We hadn't been living in Tashkent for a year when we bought the house. (Uy sotib olganimizda Toshkentda hali bir yil ham yashamayotgan edik.) ❗ Muhim eslatma: Inkor shaklidagi not yuklamasining o'rniga e'tibor bering! U har doim birinchi yordamchi fe'l — had so'zidan keyin qo'yiladi. ✅ hadn't been studying ❌ had been not studying (Bu xato hisoblanadi!)
parts.4: ❓ Past Perfect Continuous: So'roq gaplar (4/5-qism) 📌 Bugungi darsimizda Past Perfect Continuous zamonida so'roq gaplar hosil qilish qoidalarini ko'rib chiqamiz. Ushbu tuzilma o'tmishdagi muayyan vaqtgacha davom etgan harakat haqida so'rash uchun ishlatiladi. ⚙️ Umumiy so'roq gap formulasi: Had + ega + been + V-ing...? 🔎 Maxsus so'roq gap formulasi: Wh-so'z + had + ega + been + V-ing...? 📝 Amaliy misollar: 🗣️ Had you been waiting for a long time before the bus arrived? (Avtobus kelguncha uzoq vaqt kutayotgan edingizmi?) 🗣️ Had she been working at that company for three years before she quit? (U ishdan bo'shashidan oldin u yerda uch yil ishlayotgan edimi?) 🗣️ How long had they been discussing the problem before they found a solution? (Yechim topishlaridan oldin ular muammoni qancha vaqt muhokama qilishayotgan edi?) 🗣️ Why had he been running so fast before he stopped? (U to'xtashidan oldin nimaga bunchalik tez yugurayotgan edi?) 💡 Muhim eslatma: So'roq gap tuzishda had yordamchi fe'li har doim egadan oldinga o'tkaziladi, been esa fe me'yorida asosiy fe'lning -ing shakli bilan birga egadan keyin qoladi.
parts.5: 🎓 Past Perfect Continuous (5/5-qism: Amaliyot va yakun) 📌 Ko'p uchraydigan xatolar: 1. Statik fe'llarni (stative verbs: know, love, want, believe) hech qachon davomli zamonlarda ishlatmang. Ular bilan Past Perfect Continuous emas, balki Past Perfect qo'llanadi. Xato: We had been knowing him for ten years. To'g'ri: We had known him for ten years. 2. Harakatning davomiyligi (for, since) ko'rsatilmagan va oddiy ketma-ket sodir bo'lgan o'tmish voqealari uchun bu zamonni ishlatmang. Bunday holatda Past Simple yetarli bo'ladi. 📝 Amaliy mashq: Qavs ichidagi fe'llarni Past Perfect Continuous zamoniga qo'yib, bo'sh joylarni to'ldiring: 1. She was exhausted because she ___ (work) in the garden for five hours. 2. How long ___ you ___ (wait) for the bus before it finally arrived? 3. They ___ (not / play) tennis for long when it started to rain. 4. James lost his voice because he ___ (shout) at the match all evening. ✅ Javoblar: 1. had been working 2. had ... been waiting 3. had not been playing (yoki hadn't been playing) 4. had been shouting

grammar_archive.topic: Passive reporting structures (It is said that..., He is known to...)

parts.1: 📌 Passive Reporting Structures: Umumiy tushuncha (1/5) 📖 Rasmiy nutqda va yangiliklarda ma'lumot manbayi noma'lum bo'lsa yoki uni oshkor qilish shart bo'lmasa, passive reporting structures ishlatiladi. Bu tuzilmalar orqali shaxsiy fikr emas, balki ko'pchilik orasida tarqalgan xabar yoki umumiy haqiqatlar yetkaziladi. Qoida asosan say, believe, know va think kabi fe'llar yordamida yasaladi. Ushbu mavzuni o'zlashtirish ingliz tilidagi nutq va matnlaringizni yanada rasmiy hamda akademik qilishga yordam beradi. 💡 Misollar: 🗣️ It is said that the company will open a new office. (Kompaniya yangi ofis ochishi aytilmoqda.) 🗣️ He is known to be a very talented doctor. (U juda iqtidorli shifokor sifatida tanilgan.) 📝 Keyingi qismlarda ushbu seriya bo'yicha darak, inkor va so'roq gap tuzilishlarini birma-bir batafsil ko'rib chiqamiz. Kanalni kuzatib boring!
parts.2: 📢 Passive reporting structures (2/5-qism) 📌 Bugun ushbu grammatik strukturani darak gaplarda qo'llashning ikkita asosiy formulasini ko'rib chiqamiz. 📖 1-forma: It + Passive verb + that + Gap Ushbu tuzilishda ma'lumot umumiy tarzda yetkaziladi va that so'zidan keyin to'liq gap keladi. • It is said that he lives in London. (Uning Londonda yashashi aytiladi.) • It was reported that the prices increased. (Narxlar oshgani haqida xabar berildi.) 📖 2-forma: Ega + Passive verb + To-infinitive Ushbu tuzilishda xabar ob'yekti gapning egasi bo'lib keladi va unga fe'lning to-infinitive shakli ergashadi. • He is known to be a very talented doctor. (U juda iqtidorli shifokor sifatida tanilgan.) • She is believed to have completed the task. (U topshiriqni yakunlagan deb hisoblanadi.) ❗ Tez-tez uchraydigan xato: Ikkinchi tuzilishda fe me'yorida to yuklamasini tushirib qoldirish juda katta xatodir. Masalan, He is known be emas, albatta He is known to be ko'rinishida yozish shart.
